title: Product
description: A single commerce product as exposed by the ProductListController state. Field names follow the Coveo commerce field conventions (ec_* prefix).

ec_name.description: The display name of the product.

ec_category.description: Ordered list of category path segments (e.g. ["Sports", "Kayaks"]).

ec_price.description: Regular unit price in the request currency.

ec_promo_price.description: Promotional/sale price. When present and lower than ec_price, this is the effective price.

ec_images.description: Full-resolution image URLs, in display order.

ec_thumbnails.description: Thumbnail image URLs, in display order.

ec_in_stock.description: Whether the product is currently available for purchase.

ec_rating.description: Average customer rating on a 0-5 scale. Null when no ratings exist.

ec_item_group_id.description: Identifier of the parent product group (used for variant grouping).

ec_item_group_name.description: Display name of the parent product group.

clickUri.$comment: TODO(quicktype): Restore format: uri-reference when quicktype-core preserves that JSON Schema format through its TypeGraph.
clickUri.description: Absolute URL to the product detail page.

additionalFields.description: Catch-all bag for any extra fields returned by the index that are not part of the standard schema.

children.description: Product variants (e.g. sizes or colours). Each child is itself a Product.
